name: What factors drive the cost of an interior home upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What factors drive the cost of an interior home upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on square footage, material selections, and whether structural modifications or trade coordination are involved. Drywall repair and interior painting sit at the lower end of the cost spectrum, whereas high-end marble installation, custom carpentry, and framing modifications require more labor and specialized skill. To prepare for an estimate, it helps to gather your preferred material styles and list specific functional issues you want solved. Working with an owner-operated contractor helps keep overhead reasonable because carpentry, drywall, and tile are managed directly by the primary crew.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on room size, material choices like tile versus paint, structural framing needs, and whether specialized sub-trades for electrical or plumbing are required.
